description: Read-only public binding for the Momen map/list application. The page receives no API secret, session, action token, or provider payload.

truncated.note: Per-collection booleans. True means that collection hit the public row cap (500) and the list is partial; summary counts/totals are exact aggregates and are never truncated.

filter_semantics.urgency: need attribute; narrows needs and their allocations only
filter_semantics.status: need attribute; narrows needs and their allocations only

markers.no_coordinate_entities: remain in the list and tables with null coordinates

refresh.note: The Momen editor spike is blocked. A 5000 ms poll is not a verified pass of the 5000 ms reply-to-map target; record measured p50/p95 before claiming it.

privacy.cors: configured Momen origins only, GET only
privacy.pii: no sender addresses, tokens, sessions, raw messages, or provider payloads

operator_link.note: The only privileged navigation exposed publicly.

editor_acceptance_checklist: Simulation label visible and not dismissible.
Resource, urgency, and status filters with visible labels.
Markers use shape, text label, and color together.
Equivalent table/list reachable by a visible toggle with the same rows.
Detail content shows entity, resource, quantity basis, status, reference, updated time, and approximate distance.
Empty, unverified, review, and no-coordinate states are announced in text.
aria-live polite announcements for changes without moving focus.
Keyboard-only filters, markers, table, detail, and toggle.
200% text zoom and a narrow viewport do not clip content.
No action token, session, sender address, or provider payload in bound data or page source.
